theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_fd_localize
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (W : Set (Euclid P)), Bornology.IsBounded W → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V → Bornology.IsBounded V → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn V + (Ts j).boundary.massOn V) < ∞) → ∃ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (Λ : NNReal) (Ts' : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact K ∧ StrictMono φ ∧ (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts' j)) ∧ (∀ j, (Ts' j).support ⊆ K) ∧ (∀ j, (Ts' j).mass ≤ Λ ∧ (Ts' j).boundary.mass ≤ Λ) ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ W → Ts' j ω = Ts (φ j) ω
